tool_result.userMessage: 项目启动失败：服务没有在指定端口上正常响应，这次更新没有完成。原来的服务已经被重启，原来的分享链接现在可能打不开。服务需要监听 PORT 环境变量并绑定 0.0.0.0，修复启动方式后重新发布即可恢复。
tool_result.agentGuidance: The project itself failed. `detail` contains the real output (install log / port, process and app stderr). Explain the likely cause to the user from it and propose a concrete fix; ask before editing their files. Do NOT re-run the same deploy unchanged, do NOT switch language/startCmd to force it, and do NOT fall back to publishing a static placeholder page. Deploy again only after the project is fixed. This failed update had already changed the sandbox behind the existing share link, so that link may be broken now: make sure the user is told this, as stated in `userMessage`. Never work around a failure by publishing somewhere else: do NOT try to create a new app or publish to a different one.

failure_analysis_from_detail_only.mechanism: 接收器启动时先校验 tokens 与候选文件名严格一一对应，未通过即进程退出，导致 3000 端口 60 秒内无监听，被判定为 SITES_START_FAILED / retryable=false。
failure_analysis_from_detail_only.hypothesis_from_main_controller: 本轮 .upload-token 的 JSON 键沿用了旧包文件名，与 upload-metadata.json 中候选 file_name 不匹配，因而键集合校验失败。此为待验证假设，本次未读取令牌内容、未修改任何文件，无法由本回执独立证实。
failure_analysis_from_detail_only.recommended_next_step_owner: 主控在确认结果后修正 tokens 映射（键名改为候选 file_name），再决定是否重新发布。
